author: nottherealtar
install_msg: `/beanduel @user` to challenge. Accept → pick Espresso / Latte / Cold Brew. `/beanduelboard` for the standings.
name: beanduel
description: Challenge another member to a button-based café duel. Accept/Decline, then secretly pick Espresso, Latte, or Cold Brew (rock-paper-scissors triangle). Rematch button and guild W/L board.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-member bean duel wins and losses in each guild.
